_about: Imaging program presets for the Dental Machine bridge. Use one in bridge-config.json with "apps": [{ "preset": "dexis" }] and override any field (command, args, writeFile, watch, name). "verify": true means the command-line flags or bridge-file format come from public PMS bridge notes and have NOT been confirmed against that vendor's current release: test "Open in ..." once on a real workstation, and fix "args" or "writeFile" in bridge-config.json if the patient doesn't open. "handoff" says how the patient reaches the program: args (command line), file (a bridge file the program reads), file+args, or none (the program opens and staff pick the patient; images are still filed under the patient last opened from the chart on that computer). Placeholders: {patientId} {firstName} {lastName} {preferredName} {dob} (YYYY-MM-DD) {dobYMD} (YYYYMMDD) {dobMDY} (MM/DD/YYYY) {dobDMY} (DD/MM/YYYY) {dobDotted} (DD.MM.YYYY) {gender} (M/F/U) {bridgeFile} (this app's writeFile.path). Watch folders are the office's own folder under C:\DentalMachine\Export: set the imaging program to export (or auto-export) there.

presets.name: DEXIS
presets.comment: Known: classic DEXIS reads the patient from a small INI-style 'info file' ([Patients] PN/LN/FN/BD/SX) passed with @<path>; this is how common PMS bridges drive it. Assumed: the exact key names, the MM/DD/YYYY date and the default C:\DEXIS install folder.
presets.exportHelp: In DEXIS, set Export (or the DICOM/JPEG auto-export) to C:\DentalMachine\Export\DEXIS.

presets.name: DEXIS 10 / DEXIS IS
presets.comment: Known: DEXIS 10 and DEXIS Imaging Suite keep a PMS bridge compatible with classic DEXIS for most practice systems. Assumed: the same @info-file interface and the install path; newer DEXIS IS builds may want their 'DEXIS Integrator' instead - ask DEXIS support for the 'third-party PMS bridge' settings if the patient doesn't open.
presets.exportHelp: In DEXIS, set the export or auto-export folder to C:\DentalMachine\Export\DEXIS.

presets.name: Sidexis 4
presets.comment: Known: Sidexis 4 takes patients from practice software through its SLIDA 'mailbox' file (siomin.sdx), a record format the bridge does not write yet. So this preset only starts Sidexis; staff pick the patient in Sidexis, and exported images are filed under the patient last opened from the chart. Assumed: the install path.
presets.exportHelp: In Sidexis 4, use Export (DICOM or JPEG) to C:\DentalMachine\Export\Sidexis.

presets.name: CS Imaging 8 (Carestream)
presets.comment: Known: CS Imaging accepts a patient hand-off from practice software through a small patient file. Assumed: the [PATIENT] key names, the -I switch, the YYYYMMDD date and the install path. Carestream's 'PMS bridge' guide lists the exact format for your version.
presets.exportHelp: In CS Imaging, set the image export folder to C:\DentalMachine\Export\CS Imaging.

presets.name: Carestream RVG / Trophy
presets.comment: Known: the older Trophy/RVG software (TW.exe) takes the patient on the command line. Assumed: the -P (patient id) and -N (name) switch spelling and the install path. RVG sensors on CS Imaging 8 should use the CS Imaging 8 preset instead.
presets.exportHelp: In the RVG/Trophy software, export images to C:\DentalMachine\Export\RVG.

presets.name: Planmeca Romexis
presets.comment: Known: Romexis is driven from practice software by its DxStart.exe helper with the patient as quoted arguments. Assumed: the argument order (id, last, first, birth date), the DD.MM.YYYY date and the install path. Planmeca's 'Romexis PMS link' settings confirm them.
presets.exportHelp: In Romexis, export images (DICOM or JPEG) to C:\DentalMachine\Export\Romexis.

presets.name: Apteryx XrayVision
presets.comment: Known: XrayVision ships XVLauncher.exe for practice software to open a patient. Assumed: the /patid /first /last /dob switch names and the install path.
presets.exportHelp: In XrayVision, export images to C:\DentalMachine\Export\XrayVision.

presets.name: Apteryx XVWeb
presets.comment: Known: XVWeb is cloud-based and runs in the browser; captures are made with the XVWeb capture agent. Assumed: no command-line patient hand-off is available to the bridge, so this preset only watches an export folder. Set XVWeb (or its capture agent) to also save a copy to the folder.
presets.exportHelp: In XVWeb, download or export images to C:\DentalMachine\Export\XVWeb.

presets.name: VixWin
presets.comment: Known: VixWin (Platinum) opens a patient from the command line. Assumed: the -I (id) and -N (LAST^FIRST) switches and the install path.
presets.exportHelp: In VixWin, export images to C:\DentalMachine\Export\VixWin.

presets.name: Schick CDR / CDR DICOM
presets.comment: Known: CDR DICOM is normally driven from practice software through a COM/OLE interface, which a command-line bridge can't use. So this preset starts CDR; staff pick the patient there, and exported images are filed under the patient last opened from the chart. Assumed: the install path. Schick 33/Elite sensors can also use direct capture with the TWAIN sensor preset.
presets.exportHelp: In CDR DICOM, export images to C:\DentalMachine\Export\CDR.

presets.name: Dolphin Imaging
presets.comment: Known: Dolphin Imaging has a control program (DolCtrl.exe) for practice software to open a patient. Assumed: the -action/-patid/-first/-last switch names and the install path. Mostly ceph and photo work: exports land as photos unless you change the category.
presets.exportHelp: In Dolphin, export images to C:\DentalMachine\Export\Dolphin.

presets.name: MiPACS Dental Enterprise
presets.comment: Known: the MiPACS viewer accepts a patient id on its command line from practice software. Assumed: the switch spelling (-patientID:) and the install path.
presets.command: C:\Program Files (x86)\Medicor Imaging\MiPACS Dental Enterprise Viewer\MiDentView.exe
commandCandidates: C:\Program Files (x86)\Medicor Imaging\MiPACS Dental Enterprise Viewer\MiDentView.exe
C:\Program Files\Medicor Imaging\MiPACS Dental Enterprise Viewer\MiDentView.exe
presets.exportHelp: In MiPACS, export images to C:\DentalMachine\Export\MiPACS.

presets.name: TigerView
presets.comment: Known: TigerView takes a patient hand-off from practice software through a small patient file. Assumed: the key names, the /F switch and the install path.
presets.exportHelp: In TigerView, export images to C:\DentalMachine\Export\TigerView.

presets.name: Patterson Imaging (Eaglesoft)
presets.comment: Known: Patterson Imaging (the imaging module of Eaglesoft, also sold standalone) can be opened with a patient from outside Eaglesoft. Assumed: the /patient switch, the executable name and the install path; Patterson support can confirm the 'third-party bridge' command line for your version.
presets.exportHelp: In Patterson Imaging, export images to C:\DentalMachine\Export\Patterson Imaging.

presets.name: Dentrix Imaging (Dentrix Image)
presets.comment: Known: Dentrix Image is built to be opened from inside Dentrix, not by other practice software. So this preset only watches an export folder: staff capture in Dentrix Image and export there, and images are filed under the patient last opened from the chart. Assumed: no outside patient hand-off exists; set 'command' if your version has one.
presets.exportHelp: In Dentrix Image, export images to C:\DentalMachine\Export\Dentrix Image.

presets.name: Vatech EzDent-i
presets.comment: Known: EzDent-i has a launcher for practice software to open or create a patient. Assumed: the VTLauncher.exe name, the /ID /LastName /FirstName /Birth /Sex switches and the install path.
presets.exportHelp: In EzDent-i, export images to C:\DentalMachine\Export\EzDent-i.

presets.name: Midmark Progeny Imaging
presets.comment: Known: Progeny Imaging includes a bridge helper for practice software. Assumed: the PIBridge.exe name, its /PatientID /FirstName /LastName /Birthdate switches and the install path.
presets.exportHelp: In Progeny Imaging, export images to C:\DentalMachine\Export\Progeny.

presets.name: Owandy QuickVision
presets.comment: Known: QuickVision takes patients from practice software through a Windows message interface, which a command-line bridge can't send. So this preset starts QuickVision; staff pick the patient there. Assumed: the install path.
presets.exportHelp: In QuickVision, export images to C:\DentalMachine\Export\QuickVision.

presets.name: CliniView
presets.comment: Known: CliniView accepts the patient on its command line. Assumed: the single -id;last;first;birthdate argument layout and the install path.
presets.exportHelp: In CliniView, export images to C:\DentalMachine\Export\CliniView.

presets.name: Other program: patient number on the command line
presets.vendor: Any imaging program with an 'Open Dental-style' patient-ID bridge
presets.comment: Known: many imaging programs open a patient when started with the chart number as the only argument (the common 'patient ID' bridge). Set "command" to the program's .exe; add more args (e.g. "{lastName}") if its bridge guide asks for them.
presets.exportHelp: In your imaging program, export images to C:\DentalMachine\Export\Imaging.

presets.name: Other program: patient file (INI)
presets.vendor: Any imaging program that reads the patient from a file
presets.comment: Known: a common bridge style where the practice software writes the patient to a small text file and starts the program with that file's path. Change "writeFile.content" to the key names your program's bridge guide gives, and "command" to its .exe.
presets.exportHelp: In your imaging program, export images to C:\DentalMachine\Export\Imaging.

presets.name: Export folder only (camera or other software)
presets.vendor: Intraoral camera software, scanners, or any program that saves images
presets.comment: Known: no program is started; new images saved to the folder are filed under the patient last opened from the chart on this computer (or the chart number in the file name, P123_...).
presets.exportHelp: Set the program to save images to C:\DentalMachine\Export\Photos.

scanPresets.name: Fujitsu / Ricoh ScanSnap
scanPresets.comment: Known: ScanSnap models have no WIA/TWAIN driver for other programs; ScanSnap Home saves each scan as a PDF to a folder you choose. Set a ScanSnap Home profile to save to the folder below; name files P<chart#>_… (or leave the default name and file them from Documents → Scan inbox).
scanPresets.help: In ScanSnap Home: Scan settings → your profile → Save to → C:\DentalMachine\Scans\ScanSnap, File format PDF.

scanPresets.name: Copier / network scanner (scan to folder)
scanPresets.vendor: Ricoh, Canon imageRUNNER, Brother, HP, Xerox, Kyocera, Sharp
scanPresets.comment: Known: office copiers can 'scan to folder' (SMB) on the network. Share the folder below (or point the bridge at the copier's existing share) and add it here; P<chart#>_… names go to that chart, everything else to the scan inbox.
scanPresets.help: Share C:\DentalMachine\Scans\Copier on the network and add it as a 'scan to folder' destination on the copier's panel.

scanPresets.name: Scan to email (via a mail rule)
scanPresets.comment: Known: the bridge doesn't read email. Have your mail program save attachments from the scanner's address to the folder below (e.g. an Outlook rule or Power Automate), and they're filed like any scan folder.
scanPresets.help: Create a mail rule that saves attachments from the scanner's email address to C:\DentalMachine\Scans\Email.

scanPresets.name: Epson (WorkForce, DS, Perfection)
scanPresets.comment: Known: Epson Scan 2 installs a WIA driver alongside TWAIN. Assumed: the WIA device name contains EPSON (check with --list-scanners).

scanPresets.name: Canon (imageFORMULA, PIXMA, MAXIFY)
scanPresets.comment: Known: Canon's scanner drivers include WIA. Assumed: the device name contains Canon; imageFORMULA DR models may need the 'Canon DR' WIA driver from Canon's site.

scanPresets.name: Brother (ADS, MFC)
scanPresets.comment: Known: Brother's full driver package installs WIA. Assumed: the device name contains Brother.

scanPresets.name: HP (ScanJet, OfficeJet, LaserJet MFP)
scanPresets.comment: Known: HP's full software (or the Windows inbox driver) provides WIA. Assumed: the device name contains HP.

scanPresets.name: Fujitsu / Ricoh fi series (PaperStream)
scanPresets.comment: Known: fi-series scanners ship PaperStream IP drivers (TWAIN and ISIS); a WIA driver is a separate download. Assumed: the WIA device name contains 'fi-'. Without WIA, use a PaperStream Capture profile that saves to a scan folder.

scanPresets.name: Any SANE scanner (macOS / Linux)
scanPresets.comment: Known: scanimage (sane-utils / sane-backends) drives most USB and network scanners. Assumed: feeder source names 'ADF' / 'ADF Duplex' — set "sources" to what `scanimage -A` lists.
